描述_EN: from surviving mamluk textiles, it seems that blue was a favoured colour. similar textiles have not been found in china and it is possible that these silks were made specially for the mamluk empire (1250-1517). the staining may be due to their having been buried, although no archeological report exist. this fragment is part of a group of chinese silks in the v&a collection , broadly dated between the late thirteenth century and the mid-fifteenth century. the weaving may have been carried out in china and the silks then exported westwards, or it could have been done outside china by islamic craftsmen familiar with chinese patterning. mamluk and other textiles from the islamic world are known to incorporate scripts into their designs.
描述_ZN: 从现存的马穆鲁克纺织品来看，蓝色似乎是一种受欢迎的颜色。 类似的纺织品在中国没有发现，这些丝绸有可能是专门为马穆鲁克帝国（1250-1517）制作的。 染色可能是由于他们被埋葬了，虽然没有考古报告。 这块碎片是V&A收藏的一组中国丝绸的一部分，时间大致在13世纪末到15世纪中叶。 织造可能是在中国进行的，然后丝绸向西出口，也可能是在中国以外由熟悉中国图案的伊斯兰工匠完成。 众所周知，马姆鲁克和伊斯兰世界的其他纺织品在设计中都加入了文字。
